note: Prices and sources from past builds; see lib/price-cache.ts.

entries.name: Hack existing floor tiles
entries.figure: 43 to 65 per sqm of floor (standard)
entries.rationale: The source gives one S$3-8/sqft range; the basic/standard/premium split is our estimate. It is applied to the whole floor area, so lower the quantity if some rooms keep their tiles.

entries.name: Hack bathroom tiles and fixtures
entries.figure: 400 to 900 per bathroom (standard)
entries.rationale: Basic is light hacking (fixtures and a few tiles), standard a full floor-and-wall strip, premium an extensive strip incl. kerbs. BTO owners normally must wait 3 years before hacking bathroom finishes.

entries.name: Hack kitchen tiles and old cabinets
entries.figure: 1,200 to 1,800 per kitchen (standard)
entries.rationale: Only basic is a published price; full kitchen hacking is built up from per-sqft hacking rates, so standard and premium are estimates.

entries.name: Hack a non-structural wall (HDB approval)
entries.figure: 500 to 800 per wall (standard)
entries.rationale: Assumes a typical internal brick wall 8-15 ft long. HDB only allows hacking of walls it marks as non-structural.

entries.name: Dismantle and dispose old carpentry
entries.figure: 500 to 1,000 per flat (standard)
entries.rationale: Our estimate for a resale flat with several old built-ins; the tiers reflect how much old carpentry there is, not finish quality.

entries.name: Build a new partition wall
entries.figure: 108 to 161 per sqm of wall (standard)
entries.rationale: Default 8 sqm is one wall about 3 m long and 2.6 m high. All tiers are estimates.

entries.name: Floor tiling (porcelain or homogeneous) incl. screed
entries.figure: 118 to 194 per sqm of floor (standard)
entries.rationale: Sources clash (S$3.50 to S$22/sqft); basic is entry ceramic, premium large-format porcelain. Marble runs S$15-40/sqft and can exceed premium.

entries.name: Tile overlay on existing floor
entries.figure: 54 to 75 per sqm of floor (standard)
entries.rationale: Overlay is cheaper than hacking and retiling but raises the floor level; the tier split is our estimate.

entries.name: SPC / vinyl flooring
entries.figure: 65 to 97 per sqm of floor (standard)
entries.rationale: Ranges are sourced; basic is 4-5 mm SPC, premium thicker embossed planks with better underlay.

entries.name: Laminate, engineered timber or parquet
entries.figure: 108 to 194 per sqm of floor (standard)
entries.rationale: Each tier is a different, sourced material. Usually laid in bedrooms only, so lower the quantity (e.g. 0.4 of the flat).

entries.name: Bathroom wall tiling (full height)
entries.figure: 1,100 to 2,200 per bathroom (standard)
entries.rationale: The per-bathroom figure is our estimate from per-sqft rates; premium is stone or large-format tiles.

entries.name: Bathroom floor tiling
entries.figure: 250 to 450 per bathroom (standard)
entries.rationale: An estimate built from per-sqft rates; contractors often bundle it with wall tiling and waterproofing.

entries.name: Kitchen wall tiling / backsplash
entries.figure: 600 to 1,250 per kitchen (standard)
entries.rationale: All per-kitchen figures are our estimates from one supplier's per-sqft rate.

entries.name: Bathroom waterproofing membrane
entries.figure: 500 to 800 per bathroom (standard)
entries.rationale: An estimate. HDB requires a membrane when bathroom floors are redone; the required wall upturn differs between sources (100-200 mm vs 150 mm), so check with your contractor.

entries.name: False ceiling (gypsum board)
entries.figure: 86 to 129 per sqm of ceiling (standard)
entries.rationale: The tiers match published ceiling types (flat, layered, coffered). Default 20 sqm covers a living and dining area.

entries.name: Cove lighting / L-box
entries.figure: 20 to 25 per ft run (standard)
entries.rationale: An estimate; no per-foot-run price was found.

entries.name: Bathroom ceiling
entries.figure: 175 to 360 per bathroom (standard)
entries.rationale: An estimate; no Singapore aluminium-ceiling price was found.

entries.name: Kitchen cabinets (top and bottom)
entries.figure: 200 to 320 per ft run (standard)
entries.rationale: Check whether a quote is per row or for both rows, as sources differ. The premium tier is our estimate.

entries.name: Wardrobes (full height)
entries.figure: 250 to 400 per ft run (standard)
entries.rationale: Default 20 ft = master bedroom 8 ft plus two common bedrooms of 6 ft each (Smart Calculator's 4-room typical).

entries.name: TV console
entries.figure: 170 to 320 per ft run (standard)
entries.rationale: Default 8 ft is a typical 4-room console length.

entries.name: Shoe cabinet
entries.figure: 150 to 300 per ft run (standard)
entries.rationale: Default 4 ft; sources clash on the standard range.

entries.name: Study table with shelves
entries.figure: 1,040 to 2,080 per set (standard)
entries.rationale: All tiers are estimates built from per-foot rates.

entries.name: Platform bed with storage
entries.figure: 2,450 to 2,800 per bed (standard)
entries.rationale: The premium tier is an estimate; MoneySmart's higher figures (to S$8,800) include extra base cabinetry.

entries.name: Bathroom vanity cabinet
entries.figure: 645 to 840 per bathroom (standard)
entries.rationale: An estimate built from per-foot rates.

entries.name: Countertop: quartz
entries.figure: 120 to 180 per ft run (standard)
entries.rationale: Default 12 ft matches the bottom kitchen run. Quartz is the most common HDB choice.

entries.name: Countertop: compact or sintered stone
entries.figure: 160 to 250 per ft run (standard)
entries.rationale: Tick instead of quartz. Sources clash on how much dearer it is than quartz (S$50/ft more, or double).

entries.name: Countertop: granite
entries.figure: 160 to 200 per ft run (standard)
entries.rationale: The standard high and premium are estimates; sources clash on whether granite is cheaper or dearer than quartz.

entries.name: Countertop: solid surface
entries.figure: 100 to 130 per ft run (standard)
entries.rationale: The premium tier is an estimate. Solid surface is seamless and repairable but scratches more easily than quartz.

entries.name: Full-flat rewiring
entries.figure: 33 to 60 per sqm of floor (standard)
entries.rationale: Estimated from whole-flat quotes divided by typical areas; sources differ 2-3x, mainly by how many points are included.

entries.name: Power points (13A sockets)
entries.figure: 60 to 120 per point (standard)
entries.rationale: Default 8 new points for a typical 4-room; premium covers heavy-load points.

entries.name: Lighting points
entries.figure: 80 to 180 per point (standard)
entries.rationale: Standard is sourced; basic and premium are estimates.

entries.name: DB box (distribution board) upgrade
entries.figure: 400 to 700 per unit (standard)
entries.rationale: Usually needed with a full rewire or when adding aircon or oven loads.

entries.name: Light fittings (downlights, pendants)
entries.figure: 30 to 80 per piece (standard)
entries.rationale: An estimate; owners usually buy these themselves, so prices vary widely.

entries.name: Toilet bowl
entries.figure: 450 to 800 per bathroom (standard)
entries.rationale: An estimate built on Helpling's item and labour prices.

entries.name: Basin with tap
entries.figure: 300 to 600 per bathroom (standard)
entries.rationale: An estimate; no installed basin-set price was published.

entries.name: Shower screen
entries.figure: 600 to 850 per bathroom (standard)
entries.rationale: Partly estimated; premium is a sliding or full-height frameless screen.

entries.name: Shower set / rain shower
entries.figure: 330 to 500 per bathroom (standard)
entries.rationale: An estimate combining item prices and installation.

entries.name: Water heater
entries.figure: 370 to 550 per unit (standard)
entries.rationale: Partly estimated; one storage heater often serves both bathrooms.

entries.name: Water and waste piping replacement
entries.figure: 2,500 to 3,500 per flat (standard)
entries.rationale: An estimate. SingSaver advises re-piping resale flats older than 15-20 years.

entries.name: Kitchen sink and tap
entries.figure: 250 to 600 per kitchen (standard)
entries.rationale: An estimate.

entries.name: Main door (fire-rated)
entries.figure: 1,000 to 1,200 per door (standard)
entries.rationale: Sourced; replacing the frame can add more.

entries.name: Main gate
entries.figure: 700 to 900 per gate (standard)
entries.rationale: Partly estimated; the 2022 figures may be low today.

entries.name: Bedroom doors
entries.figure: 420 to 600 per bedroom (standard)
entries.rationale: Sourced; the ranges exclude a new frame.

entries.name: Bathroom doors
entries.figure: 380 to 500 per bathroom (standard)
entries.rationale: From one type of source (supplier ads).

entries.name: Window replacement (HDB-approved contractor)
entries.figure: 250 to 380 per window panel (standard)
entries.rationale: An estimate; no prices from HDB-approved window contractors were found. The default of 20 panels for a 4-room is our guess.

entries.name: Window grilles (invisible)
entries.figure: 12 to 18 per sqft (standard)
entries.rationale: Default 60 sqft covers a few windows; conventional grilles were not priced.

entries.name: Whole-flat painting
entries.figure: 10 to 18 per sqm of floor (standard)
entries.rationale: An estimate; sources differ 3-4x by prep work, paint grade and number of coats.

entries.name: Feature wall / specialty paint
entries.figure: 840 to 1,260 per wall (standard)
entries.rationale: An estimate from per-sqft rates.

entries.name: Aircon System 2
entries.figure: 1,800 to 2,500 per system (standard)
entries.rationale: Sourced. Brackets, extra piping and power points are often extra.

entries.name: Aircon System 3
entries.figure: 2,200 to 2,980 per system (standard)
entries.rationale: Sourced; the same model varies from S$2,890 to S$4,349 between shops.

entries.name: Aircon System 4
entries.figure: 2,800 to 3,400 per system (standard)
entries.rationale: Sourced; the usual choice for a 4-room or 5-room flat.

entries.name: Hob and hood set
entries.figure: 635 to 870 per set (standard)
entries.rationale: The premium tier is an estimate.

entries.name: Built-in oven
entries.figure: 899 to 1,210 per unit (standard)
entries.rationale: Sourced retail prices.

entries.name: Interior design fee
entries.figure: 1,500 to 6,000 per flat (standard)
entries.rationale: Sources are old and clash (3-15% of the job). Contractors build project management into their margins.

entries.name: Professional Engineer endorsement
entries.figure: 800 to 2,000 per job (standard)
entries.rationale: The same at every tier; only needed for certain wall works.

entries.name: HDB renovation permit
entries.figure: 0 to 50 per flat (standard)
entries.rationale: Probably free or nominal; check with your contractor.

entries.name: Floor and lift protection
entries.figure: 400 to 650 per flat (standard)
entries.rationale: An estimate.

entries.name: Debris haulage
entries.figure: 250 to 400 per lorry trip (standard)
entries.rationale: Default 3 trips for a full resale job; the tiers reflect access and volume.

entries.name: Post-renovation cleaning
entries.figure: 4 to 5 per sqm of floor (standard)
entries.rationale: An estimate from three overlapping sources.
